answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 36567 Country: India Title: Currently I am living in rented house and we have a land and planning to build the house for our use. Can we take the house loan for the same Question: Currently I am living in rented house and we have a land and planning to build the house for our use. Can we take the house loan for the same? There is income tax benefit for housing loan and can we avail this? Answer ID: 36567 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 288/288/M=1433) One has to pay interest in case of receiving home loan and hadith curses doing interest based dealing. Hence one should avoid taking interest based loan without exigent need. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
